title: A Complete Classification of 2-Linear Neighborhood Complexes
summary: Let $G$ be a nonempty finite simple graph. We study when the Stanley-Reisner ideal of its neighborhood complex has a $2$-linear resolution. Combining Fröberg's theorem with the classical hypertree criterion, we obtain the following equivalent description in graph terms: $G$ is bipartite, its indexed open neighborhoods are Helly, and every induced cycle of length at least eight has a filling from each color class.
